title: D_f at non-power-of-2 lattice sizes (lattice-artifact diagnostic for EXP-0009 ABNORMAL)
note: FOLLOW-UP TO EXP-0009 (ABNORMAL). EXP-0009 measured D_f=1.8697 (theory 91/48=1.8958, tol 0.015) at L in {128,256,512,1024} — ALL POWER-OF-2 — with all gates PASSING. This experiment tests the lattice-size-artifact hypothesis (borrowed from coherent-optical-ai-sandbox grid-locking at 256^2): if D_f recovers to theory at non-power-of-2 sizes, the ABNORMAL was a discretization artifact, not physics. Fresh streams; no EXP-0009 cells reused. FROZEN before any execution.

D_f.test: if D_f within tol at ALL non-P2 L -> lattice artifact confirmed; if ANY outside tol -> finite-size correction likely

gates.C1: full-cell rerun (L=253, p_c) cluster census bit-identical (sha256)
gates.C7: pure-Python union-find at L=127,253 (subsample n=30): per-realization M_max and chi bit-identical, D_f within 3 joint-SE

decision_rule.LATTICE_ARTIFACT: D_f within tol at ALL non-P2 L -> ABNORMAL was lattice-size discretization artifact
decision_rule.FINITE_SIZE_CORRECTION: D_f outside tol at ANY non-P2 L -> genuine finite-size correction; proceed to L=2048/4096 diagnostic
